title: Critique of Pure Reason
author: Various
content:
English-language translations of Kritik der reinen Vernunft include:
(1838) Critick of Pure Reason by Francis Haywood
(1855) Critique of Pure Reason by J. M. D. Meiklejohn (transcription project)
(1881) Immanuel Kant's Critique Of Pure Reason by F. Max Müller
In The Philosophy of Kant in extracts by John Watson
(1882) Extracts from Critique of Pure Reason (1st ed.)
(1891) Extracts from Critique of Pure Reason (2nd ed.)
(1929) Critique of Pure Reason by Norman Kemp Smith
(1996) Critique of Pure Reason by Werner S. Pluhar ISBN 978-0-87220-257-3 (pbk.) ISBN 978-0-87220-258-0 (cloth)
(1998) Critique of Pure Reason by Paul Guyer and Allen W. Wood ISBN 0521657296
